title: Package assets and configure platform CI
objective: Package the flat src/*.py command modules, schemas, and installable assets and configure platform CI without introducing a package directory layer.

acceptance_criteria.description: Build and install the complete flat-module dependency closure and exact schema/guidance assets in clean supported environments, updating the installer catalog without regressing its safe bootstrap behavior
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-037 owned behavior tests and structured handoff evidence

acceptance_criteria.description: Configure Linux/Windows validation/build matrix and report actual support without live provider dependencies
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-037 failure-case tests and structured handoff evidence

input_contracts: src/ai.py, src/install.py, and src/validate_foundation.py flat entry points
handoff:TASK-031 installer and asset ownership transferred for final packaging
output_contracts: release public behavior described by this task acceptance; final installer catalog includes canonical role guides and every flat runtime dependency introduced through TASK-034 wiring
size_rationale: One component outcome with two bounded acceptance checks; no central registry edits. Split further through isolation review if implementation exceeds this estimate.
out_of_scope: Changing shared contracts without a new prerequisite task
Production provider integration, paid services, remote publication and product-scope changes
handoff_requirements: Exact base/commit and verified changed paths
Actual test command evidence and acceptance mapping
Public interface/dependency notes, deviations and risks
